findings.desc: diagnose mode dispatches the architect PLAN_YAML prompt but validates for root_cause+confidence, so every diagnose run exits 9 blocked/empty_response and root-cause.md is never written
planner is unbound in diagnose mode (assigned only at line 519, after the diagnose block) so a floor/degraded pool aborts under set -u with rc=1 and a mislabelled provider_error gate
retry appends failure reasons to plan-arm-<arm>.mission but run_planner_arm rewrites that file with > on dispatch, so the single retry re-runs a byte-identical prompt
critic mission reads plan-arm-<critic_arm>.yaml with a hardcoded plan-arm-codex.yaml fallback, so in the default cross-arm case the critic reviews an empty ARCHITECT DRAFT
suite fails as shipped (rc=1, 1 pass 1 fail) because the engine comment at line 399 contains the substring persona-engine, contradicting the build summary green claim
both diagnose suites are grep-on-source only and never execute --mode diagnose, so they report green while the diagnose runtime path is 100% broken
skeleton write clobbers a pre-existing valid context.yaml before any arm runs, so a blocked run permanently replaces a good plan with a judgment-free skeleton

regex `claude  +-p` (ERE) requires 2+ spaces before -p, so it never matches the realistic single-space `claude -p` invocation the engine's own header calls a "CRITICAL review finding" — the guard is blind to the exact regression it claims to catch (verified: injecting `claude -p "x"` into a copy of the engine still passes this check).

this stray file (not listed anywhere in build-summary.md's "Files changed" table, not among the "Plan-run suites (all pass)" results) currently FAILS when run (`bash plugins/leadv2/scripts/tests/test-diagnose-no-pe-constants.sh` → rc=1, "FAIL: engine contains PE constants: persona-engine-string") because it greps the engine source for the literal string "persona-engine" and trips on the engine's own header comments (e.g. "no persona-engine constants"); it ships in the diff in a red state and build-summary's "all pass" claim does not account for it.
